title: Field extension: expression
description: An expression in place of the value — a template computing it on each run —: the field switched to an editor of `language`, and back; it starts as an expression when its value matches `pattern`. The value is sent under the field's name, as text, whichever it is.

pattern.description: A regular expression a value is an expression by.

rows.description: The editor's lines, when the field is one line.
